_readme: Gates deliberately NOT wired into `npm run verify`, each with the reason why.
This file is the ONLY sanctioned way for a registered verify:* gate to sit outside
the suite — verify:chains (C2) fails the build on any unlisted orphan, and C4 fails
on any entry here that is stale or unjustified. Adding a line is a reviewed decision,
not a default. If a gate cannot run in CI, say exactly what it needs; if it is simply
broken, fix it or delete it — do not park it here.
Currently EMPTY, and that is the intended steady state: as of 2026-07-16 all 300
